# Cascade deletes may remove large dependent data

Foreign keys on relationships and provenance use ON DELETE CASCADE, so deleting an entity will automatically delete dependent relationship and provenance rows. This risks accidental or large data loss if entities are removed unintentionally.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/storage/schema.py` — `knowledge_compiler.storage.schema.RelationshipRow`
- `knowledge_compiler/storage/schema.py` — `knowledge_compiler.storage.schema.ProvenanceRow`
